The '''Aurodium Spoon''' was a place located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lola Curich]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. In existence by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], the [[Aurodium/Legends|Aurodium]] Spoon was placed in a public square full of boutique shops and [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]], with a pedestrian tunnel opening onto one side of the square. In 67 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and his [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]] pursued a a [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifting]] [[Unidentified Shi'ido|Shi'ido]] in the square in which the Aurodium Spoon resided. However, by changing to the form of a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]], the [[Shi'ido]] eluded the pair until Plagueis directed his [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] attention to the Askajian currently passing by the Aurodium Spoon. In the end, the pair captured the Shi'ido.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aurodium Spoon appears in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Darth P" />
